<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

s06 (#137) works end to end; its first dogfood found five rough edges, one of which (F75) makes a merger read 'no verdict yet' when one exists. Small and self-contained: one coder after the PEC batch.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Make pij outputs find a verdict by its short head, print a human line on write, warn on off-list kinds and undefined subjects, and say where the index starts.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- An outputs adopt verb for pre-s06 history (F79 is documented, not built).
- Changing the output path pattern.

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Source: docs-system's s06 dogfood note, written with pij output (governance roles/docs-system/outputs/2026-11/06-note-step-s06.dd.json, 2026-11-06 23:50). F75: `pij outputs --subject pr:141 --head bfc5c54` gave 0 outputs while the full sha gave 1; the filename itself uses the 7-char head. F76 is the F31/F42/F58 family. F77: `pij output verdict --role docs-system` was accepted though the role lists deliverable, note. F78: only pr:N is documented. F79: about 20 hand-written docs-system outputs are not indexed.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
